messages:
sarah_cs: Hey team — Northbridge Financial is in week 2 of onboarding and I want to propose a recurring enablement rhythm to reduce churn risk. Renewal conversation is in 11 weeks, account health score slipped from 9 -> 7 after their infra hiccup. Can we lock a weekly 30m office hours + biweekly deep-dive workshop cadence?

mike_success: +1 on weekly touch. 30m for troubleshooting, yes. For deep-dive: 60–90m? call it "integration workshop".

anna_enable: 60m deep-dive feels right. Agenda idea: 15m roadmap + Qs, 30m hands-on config (dedicated routing, batching), 15m action items. I can draft slides. :white_check_mark:

james_se: Heads-up — their SRE wants a preflight checklist for Dedicated migration. Could we include a short prework doc and a quick runbook in the workshop? I can add an excerpt from the infra checklist.

olivia_csm: Tagging risk: they reported requests timing out last Friday which knocked confidence. If we don't show measurable perf wins before the renewal, this could become a negotiation lever. Recommend we do an initial 1:1 with their PM this week to surface blockers.

sarah_cs: Good point. Olivia, can you run the 1:1? I can set up the weekly office hours starting next Tuesday. Polling 3 slots: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT, Wed 16:00-16:30 PT, Thu 08:00-08:30 PT. Which is preferred?

olivia_csm: I can do Tue 10:00. I'll confirm with their PM.

anna_enable: If Tue 10:00 works, I'll schedule recurring invites and attach preliminary agenda + deck. Draft deck link: https://drive.redwood.example/northbridge-onboard-v1 (will update).

mike_success: Quick ask — can we require 10m prework? Just: share their current request/latency logs (zip) and the active config. That will make the 30m troubleshooting useful.

james_se: I'll prepare a short runbook snippet and a `curl` example they can run to capture latency profiles. Paste for their SRE: ```bash
curl -sS -w "time_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

sarah_cs: Perfect. After the first 2 sessions we'll capture NPS and a short feedback form (2 Qs: "Did this session unblock you?" + "Top remaining blocker?"). If NPS trends down or blocker counts >3, we'll schedule an executive touch.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invites sent when meeting thread contains at least one confirmed slot and attendees list.

olivia_csm: Confirmed with PM — Tue 10:00 PT works. PM requested we cover routing fallbacks and cost controls in the first deep-dive.

anna_enable: Noted. I'll add those to the agenda and tag James for the runbook portion. I'll send invites and the prework checklist by EOD. :rocket:

sarah_cs: Thanks everyone — tagging this as action items: Olivia = 1:1 PM this week; Anna = schedule invites + deck; James = runbook + curl snippet; Mike = compile perf benchmark suggestions. We want observable improvements in 3 weeks to present at renewal prep.

mike_success: On it. I'll also add a quick A/B test plan for batching configs to show token-cost delta.

olivia_csm: I'll capture PM sentiment after the 1:1 and update the account health sheet.

sarah_cs: Great. Closing the thread once invites are out. :slightly_smiling_face:
